A '''Nikto''' biker was a member of the speed biker gang [[Kintan Striders Gang]] who are on the [[Tosche Station]] on [[Tatooine]]. One night they spent their time in a pub of Tosche and made troubles. Among the patrons were [[Camie Marstrap]] and [[Laze Loneozner]]. The Nikto snatched food from their table and drunk one of their drinks. Laze said "This is not right", prompting the Nikto to ask if he said something. Laze stands and repeats himself louder to Camie's dismay. The Kintan Striders grab and restrain Laze and Camie. One of the Niktos beated him with a stun baton. However, they were interrupted by [[Boba Fett]]. 
Fett walked into the cantina armed with a gaderffii stick and rifle. The Kintan Striders fetched melee weapons and attacked Fett. Fett disarmed one of his attackers. A second miner shot at him but Fett shot him first. Fett fought the remaining gang members, wounding and killing some with his gaderffii stick. Fett then exits the cantina and inspects their speeder bikes.<ref name="Tribes" />

After reclaiming his [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray''-31-class patrol and attack craft]],<ref name="Storm" /> ''[[Slave I]]'',<ref name="Slave I">{{Databank|boba-fetts-starship|''Slave I''}}</ref> around [[9 ABY]], Fett [[Attack on the Kintan Striders|intercepted]] the Kintan Striders while they rode through the dunes of Tatooine and opened fire on them. He killed all member of the bikers.<ref name="Storm">{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}}</ref>
